```{r setup, include=FALSE}
```

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

#Start by installing the neccesary packages.
library(leaflet)
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
```

Load the data from the Excel file, and create the map. 

```{r map, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.width=10, fig.height=7}

# 1. Load the data
witch_data_early <- read_excel("data/Finalproject data1.xlsx")
witch_data_late <- read_excel("data/Finalproject data1.xlsx", sheet = 2)

# 2. Clean the data individually for both periods
witch_data_early_clean <- witch_data_early %>%
  mutate(
    Latitude = as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", Latitude)),
    Longitude = as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", Longitude))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Latitude) & !is.na(Longitude))

witch_data_late_clean <- witch_data_late %>%
  mutate(
    Latitude = as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", Latitude)),
    Longitude = as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", Longitude))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Latitude) & !is.na(Longitude))

# 3. Build the interactive map with layers
interactive_map <- leaflet() %>%
  
  # --- Background Map Layers ---
  addTiles(group = "Standard Map") %>% 
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldImagery, group = "Satellite") %>% 
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron, group = "Light Map") %>%
  
  # Center the initial view over Denmark
  setView(lng = 9.5, lat = 56, zoom = 6) %>% 
  
  # --- Data Layer for Period 1 (1609-1616) ---
  addMarkers(
    data = witch_data_early_clean,
    lng = ~Longitude,  
    lat = ~Latitude,   
    popup = ~paste("<b>Name:</b>", Navn, "<br>", "<b>City:</b>", By),
    label = ~Navn,
    group = "1609-1616 Trials",
    clusterOptions = markerClusterOptions() 
  ) %>%
  
  # --- Data Layer for Period 2 (1620-1626) ---
  addMarkers(
    data = witch_data_late_clean,
    lng = ~Longitude,  
    lat = ~Latitude,   
    popup = ~paste("<b>Name:</b>", Navn, "<br>", "<b>City:</b>", By),
    label = ~Navn,
    group = "1620-1626 Trials",
    clusterOptions = markerClusterOptions() 
  ) %>%
  
  # --- Layer Control Menu ---
  addLayersControl(
    baseGroups = c("Standard Map", "Satellite", "Light Map"),
    overlayGroups = c("1609-1616 Trials", "1620-1626 Trials"),
    options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
  )

# 4. Display the finalized map
interactive_map
```
